title: The Quiet Scholarship
author: Petra Vane
blurb: Hazel Marchetti, the new kid at a school built over something old, has spent twenty years being so careful it hurts. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must decide who to be when the labels come off before prom.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
